paragraphs.source_en: “SO WHAT” Harry shouted. “Don’t you understand? If Snape gets hold of the Stone, Voldemort’s coming back! Haven’t you heard what it was like when he was trying to take over? D’you think he’ll leave you and your families alone if Gryffindor wins the house cup?
